purpose: Robustness test of the V1.6 ATR/structure disaster stop. The goal is to identify a broad stable parameter region, not the single best historical point.

researchPolicy.test2026: Descriptive only; already examined in prior research.
researchPolicy.selectionRule: Do not promote a parameter merely because it has the highest 2025 return. Prefer a plateau where neighboring ATR/structure settings also pass train+validation gates.

robustGate.drawdown: maxDrawdownPct must be less severe than MA5_ONLY in both 2024 and 2025
robustGate.trainValidation: All basic and drawdown conditions must pass in both 2024 and 2025.

limitations: This is a parameter sensitivity study, not permission to optimize on 2025 or 2026.
Daily OHLC stop-touch assumptions cannot reconstruct exact intraday path.
The structure low uses prior-session rolling lows only, avoiding same-day look-ahead.
Current-listed security master and Yahoo history retain survivorship/data-source limitations.
Forward Decision Ledger remains the cleanest validation for production promotion.
